Name: Magnet Fishing
Author: Daenvil
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qZJevsU.png[/img]﻿

Magnet fishing rods are a [b]new upgradeable tool[/b] that is used in the same way as a regular fishing rod. The only difference is in the kind of baits that you can attach to it (see [i]Magnetic Boosters[/i] section) and the kind of items you fish with it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qs1Ef6v.png[/img]

All fishing[b] tackles/bobbers can also be used in the magnet rods[/b], with the same effects as in regular fishing.

How to obtain and upgrade:
[spoiler]
You can obtain a magnet fishing rod in two ways:

[list]
[*][b]One will be gifted for free via mail[/b] by Gunther on the 3rd day of the game (if you are installing this on an existing save, it will arrive the day after you load the game)
[*]You can purchase it from Clint's shop for 2000g
[/list]
The basic magnet fishing rod doesn't have any attachment slots. Then you can upgrade it at Clint's, like any other tool, except that the magnet fishing rod only has two additional tiers:

[list]
[*][b]Gold magnet rod[/b]: costs 1 regular magnet fishing rod, 5 gold bars, and 5000g. Has an attachment slot for magnetic boosters (bait).
[*][b]Iridium magnet rod[/b]: costs 1 gold magnet rod, 5 iridium bars, and 15000g. Has two attachment slots: one for boosters and one for tackles.
[/list]
There's an additional upgrade: the [b]Advanced magnet rod[/b], which is obtained along the regular advanced fishing rod when achieving mastery in the fishing skill.
[/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/s0oIdKp.png[/img]

Magnetic boosters are the equivalent of bait for magnet fishing, having the exact same effect. There's a booster equivalent for each vanilla bait (except targeted bait, for now).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IqeRR5p.png[/img]

List of boosters and how to obtain them:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Magnetic Booster: same effect as Bait. Purchaseable at Clint's. Recipe unlocked at Fishing lvl. 2.
[*]Deluxe Booster: same effect as Deluxe Bait. Purchaseable at Clint's. Recipe unlocked at Fishing lvl. 4.
[*]EM Booster: same effect as Wild Bait. Recipe unlocked at 4❤ with Demetrius (mail) OR at Fishing lvl. 8.
[*]Multipolar Booster: same effect as Magnet. Recipe unlocked at Fishing lvl. 9.
[*]Magic Booster: same effect as Magic Bait. Purchaseable at Mr. Qi's gem shop.
[*]Challenge Booster: same effect as Challenge Bait. Recipe unlocked at Fishing mastery.
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MppDl5O.png[/img]

Some of the items that you can catch by magnet fishing are:

[list]
[*]Algae, trash, and jelly (same rates as with vanilla fishing)
[*]Any kind of [b]geode[/b]
[*]Some [b]minerals[/b] like hematite, iron ores, or bars
[*]Some [b]artifacts[/b]
[*][b]Tacklers [/b]and [b]bobbers[/b]
[*]Some items like [b]bombs [/b]or [b]sprinklers[/b]
[*][b]Legendary artifacts[/b] (custom items that are obtainable in the same spots as [b]legendary fish[/b])
[/list][b]Items will vary by your Fishing level, current location, weather, season, etc.[/b] If you want to see the full details check the README file of the mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kr9M072.png[/img]﻿

[i]Note: custom quests can be disabled. Check the Configuration Options section to customize which quests appear in the game.[/i]

[b]Quests:[/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*]The "Help Wanted" board will sometimes have requests to magnet-fish random items
[*]At some point after you reach Fishing level 5, Demetrius will ask you to fish a Dwarf Gadget
[*]At some point after you reach Fishing level 7, Rasmodius will ask you to fish a Strange Doll
[*]At some point after you reach Fishing level 9 and have access to the sewers, Kent will ask you to fish a Mega Bomb
[/list][/spoiler]
[b]Special orders:[/b]
[spoiler][list]
[*]  Demetrius will ask you to magnet-fish a variety of items for his research
[*]  Demetrius will ask you to magnet-fish 15 of a specific item
[*]  (If Ginger Island is unlocked) Gunther will ask you to magnet-fish 12 pirate doubloons (only available during this quest)
[*]  (On Qi's walnut room) Mr. Qi will ask you to magnet-fish all five legendary artifacts within three days
[/list][/spoiler]
Interactions with [b]festivals[/b]:
[spoiler][list]
[*][b]Annual Trout Derby[/b]: if magnet fishing during this festival, you have a chance of finding golden tags, which you can exchange for the regular prizes.
[*][b]Desert Festival[/b]: You have a chance of getting calico eggs by magnet fishing during the festival. On the 3rd day of the festival, you can do Willy's golden bobber challenge by magnet fishing.
 The other festivals still don't have any special interactions with magnet fishing.[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6i3GZEw.png[/img]

You can set these options either in-game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (recommended) or by manually editing the "config.json" file which is automatically
created in the mod folder when running it for the first time.

[list]
[*][b]HelpWantedQuests[/b]: controls which fishing-related quests can appear on the Help Wanted board. Valid options: "Both" (default), "OnlyVanilla", "OnlyMagnetFishing".
[*][b]MailQuests[/b]: controls which fishing-related quests are given to the player via mail (such as the "catch a pufferfish" quest given by Demetrius). Valid options: "Both" (default), "OnlyVanilla", "OnlyMagnetFishing".
[*][b]SpecialOrders[/b]: controls which fishing-related special orders are offered. Valid options: "Both" (default), "OnlyVanilla", "OnlyMagnetFishing".
[*][b]RenameVanillaItems[/b]: changes the names and descriptions of some vanilla items. Currently only renames "Magnet" to "Magnetic Bait". Default: true.
[*][b]ReskinFishingSkill[/b]: changes names, descriptions, and icons related to the fishing skill and its professions in order to include magnet fishing. Default: true
[/list][size=4][b][u]Mod Compatibility[/u][/b][/size][size=5][b][u]
[/u][/b][/size]As this mods just adds content and doesn't modify any vanilla behavior, it [b]should be compatible with almost any mod[/b]. Let me know if not.

New locations added by mods will only have very basic magnet-fishable items in those new locations, but the mod won't break. I plan to improve this in the future and integrate this mod better with popular mods such as Stardew Valley Expanded.
